preconditions.description: The number of vertices N is between 3 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of queries M is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U[i] <= N and 1 <= V[i] <= N for i in range(N-1))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= P[i] <= N and 1 <= Q[i] <= N for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each query specifies vertices within the range 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(P[i] != Q[i] for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each query specifies distinct start and end vertices.
Each start vertex P[i] in a query is not a leaf vertex.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly M lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= output[i] <= N for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == max_cool_sequence_length(P[i], Q[i]) for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the maximum length of a cool sequence for the corresponding query.
